dependency_notes: Single-story epic. No inter-story dependencies. S1 is self-contained inside src/marmot/; the adapter and its test are the only new artifacts.
mock_resolution_plan: No temporary mocks are introduced. The EventSigner stub used in the unit test is a permanent test fixture (inline stub in the test file); it does not model a dependency that a future story must implement.

stories.name: nip42-auth-adapter-and-wiring
stories.title: Add NIP-42 AUTH to MarmotProvider's NDK
stories.description: Implement the EventSigner-to-NDKSigner adapter, wire ndk.signer and ndk.relayAuthDefaultPolicy before ndk.connect() inside MarmotProvider's init callback, add the defensive signer guard, and ship a direct adapter unit test covering pubkey getter, blockUntilReady(), and sign() delegation. No external deps added; no files outside src/marmot/ touched.

includes: src/marmot/client.tsx — add NDKAuthPolicies import, define EventSignerNdkAdapter (inline or re-export from sibling), wire ndk.signer and ndk.relayAuthDefaultPolicy before ndk.connect()
src/marmot/event-signer-ndk-adapter.ts — new file (optional layout): adapter class implementing the full NDKSigner surface
src/marmot/event-signer-ndk-adapter.test.ts — new file: direct adapter unit test (pubkey getter, blockUntilReady, sign delegation)
excludes: src/lib/nostr.ts — bunker/NIP-46/NIP-07 signer construction is out of scope
src/marmot/network.ts and all other src/marmot/* modules — unrelated
e2e/ — no new e2e test for AUTH-gated relay (separate epic per spec §Out of Scope)

test_fixtures.description: Inline EventSigner stub (getPublicKey + signEvent vi.fn()) used in the adapter unit test — follows the canonical pattern from src/marmot/forget-device.test.ts:131-139
